scope_details: Thursday only — Jacksonville Jaguars at Baltimore Ravens, November 5, 2026

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

methodology_overrides: Use the 20-game 25th percentile (P25); replace the prior P16 measure.
Prioritize alternate lines where the player's 7th percentile (P7), calculated from the same 20-game historical distribution used for P25, is above the selected alternate line.

percentile_statistics.p7: 20-game 7th percentile, standard linear interpolation; prioritize Stage 2 alternate thresholds below P7

screening_summary.qualification_rule: Current main-market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10.
screening_summary.percentile_rule: P25 and P7 calculated from exactly 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games; unavailable when fewer than 20.
